name: Karolina i ejo svidanija!
source:
One day, Karolina came across a brochure advertising a dating site and decided to try finding the man of her dreams.

Will Karolina find true love, or will it all end in failure? You’ll only find out by playing the game!

[Translated from [url=https://bolevich.itch.io/caroline-and-her-dates]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某一天，卡罗琳娜偶然看到了一份婚恋网站的宣传册，决定试着在上面寻找自己的梦中情人。

卡罗琳娜究竟能否觅得真爱，还是会落得竹篮打水一场空？唯有亲自游玩才能揭晓答案！
